Date: Wed, 30 Dec 2026 08:12:00 -0500
Subject: Invoice routing and who sends invoices?

Hi Connor,

We’re getting our AP systems lined up for Redwood and I need to confirm a couple of things before we finalize the PO:

- Who will be the canonical invoice emitter (Redwood or BlueRidge)?
- What delivery channel do you support as the primary (portal push, email PDF, or SFTP)?
- We also need VAT evidence attached or a link to your certificate for our records.

Our preferences are portal-first, but we can accept email copies if portal onboarding will take longer. Also please confirm whether invoices can include our PO number in the header and whether you can send a consolidated monthly invoice for multiple internal cost centers.

Thanks — Evan
Evan Torres
Procurement Manager, BlueRidge Analytics

Subject: Re: Invoice routing and who sends invoices?

Hi Evan — thanks for the clear ask. Quick answers up front, then a proposed path: 

1) Canonical emitter: Redwood will be the official invoice issuer for charges related to your account (we can sign an addendum if your procurement needs that in contract).

2) Delivery channel: We recommend portal-first (our billing Portal with PUSH and API webhooks) with an automatic email copy to your AP mailbox for the first 60 days while you finish portal onboarding. If you prefer SFTP instead of email copies we can enable that as a fallback.

3) VAT evidence: attaching the VAT certificate and a sample invoice so you can confirm fields. We can embed PO numbers in the invoice header and support a monthly consolidated invoice option.

Proposed timeline:
- Today: Confirm billing contact + AP inbox and whether SFTP fallback is desired.
- 2 business days: We share Portal enrollment invite + sample payload.
- 5–7 business days: Portal onboarding and initial invoice format verification.

Can you share AP contact name/email and the exact PO header format you require?

Connor O'Brien
Customer Success — Billing Operations
Redwood Inference
connor_obrien@redwood.com

Hi Evan — looping in Finance to confirm operational details. A couple of clarifications from our side: 

- Portal enrollment: when you accept the invite, the Portal will accept a billing contact and an AP inbox. We’ll set the portal as the primary delivery and an email fanout to the AP inbox you provide.
- Consolidation: we can generate a single monthly invoice that summarizes charges across multiple internal cost centers if you supply the cost center mapping (spreadsheet or simple mapping key).
- PO handling: we’ll add a PO header field and validate that PO on receipt to help your AP auto-match. Please confirm whether you need PO on the invoice filename or only on the invoice header payload.

Operational ask — from BlueRidge: please confirm the exact AP email we should copy (or an SFTP drop URL + SSH key contact if you want SFTP), and provide a sample PO header exactly as it appears in your ERP. Once we have that we’ll push a Portal invite and schedule a short verification call.

Expected owners / next steps:
- BlueRidge: send AP contact + PO sample (Evan or Maya)
- Redwood (Connor/Kimberly): send Portal invite + confirm consolidated invoice config
- Finance: will confirm final invoice schema after verification call

Thanks — Kim
